instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "When a new day starts (UTC), set my AI's spend today back to zero", and give it spend_authority_ref.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:reset-daily-spend and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Sets the spend authority's total for today back to zero the first time it runs on a new UTC day, and remembers that day; every later run the same day changes nothing.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: spend-authority (records:read, records:write).
